snippet.title: City-Defence Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Hi, I’m Sebastian, a solo game developer from Germany, and this is my first released game. It’s available on Steam, the Apple App Store, and the Google Play Store.
There’s no pay-to-win, no subscriptions, and no ads. Just buy it once and enjoy—exactly how games should be.
